name: tandem-desktop
description: Native desktop viewer for a shared remote browser
author: Samin Yasar

scripts.dist: bun run build && bun run icons && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs
scripts.dist:mac: bun run build && bun run icons && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --mac --arm64 --x64
scripts.dist:win: bun run build && bun run icons && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --win --x64
scripts.dist:linux: bun run build && bun run icons && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --linux --x64
